SCRIPT.ENGLISH: You’ve got a little eye gunk—
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Ada sedikit belek tuh di matamu—

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: If there’s anything you want, just say the word.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 你有什麼想要的東西就儘管說吧
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 欲しいものがあったら何でも言ってくださいね
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Kalau kamu butuh apa-apa, tinggal bilang aja.
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Se quiser alguma coisa, é só pedir.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اگر چیزی می خواهید، فقط کلمه را بگویید.

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: We’re your personal maids now, Yuman.
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 我们可是宥万先生的专属女仆哦

SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Sekarang kami ini pelayan pribadimu, Yuman.
